title: What's New: Run Page Scripts in CICD Pipelines (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introducing Page Script Replayer for Pipelines
How to Use the BC Replayer Package
Managed DevOps Solutions and Future Support

features.name: Page Scripting Tool
features.description: A tool that allows customers and consultants to record and replay user actions directly in the web client for creating user acceptance tests.
features.status_evidence_quote: an enhancement to the page scripting tool that we launched in the previous release as a preview
caveats: Requires watching previous launch event for full context

features.name: Page Script Replayer for CI/CD Pipelines
features.description: A standalone page script replayer distributed as an NPM package that enables running recorded page scripts in CI/CD pipelines for automated regression testing without manual client-based replay.
caveats: Requires Node.js, Playwright, and additional dependencies
No setup required but dependencies must be installed

features.name: AL-Go for GitHub Support for Page Script Replayer
features.description: Support for the BC replay page scripting replayer will be added to managed DevOps solutions, with focus on AL-Go for GitHub in the near future.
features.status_evidence_quote: support for the BC replay page scripting replayer will come out soon in those different solutions
caveats: ALOps and Alpaca support also planned
